research_attempts.query_text: Robert E Walters; NARA OSS index context; CIA Reading Room exact-name domain check; Library of Congress collection check; exact-name and meaningful variants; OSS, rank, branch, assignment and identifier clues; employer and occupation 1940; obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory and archival searches; indexed Box 815; protected identifiers used only in private official-record comparison
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Unbridged namesakes, search-result snippets, commercial people-finder pages, unsourced genealogy, relatives, modern or postwar-only leads, and sources without an OSS, protected-identifier, rank, unit, or personnel-file bridge were rejected. The John C Wantland directory salesman, unrelated Robert Wampler biographies, British John Warburton namesakes, and modern Waples results were not assigned. Historical occupation categories were not converted into named employers.
research_attempts.research_notes: Common-name results supplied no OSS assignment, protected-identifier, employer, occupation, or Box 815 personnel-file bridge. Exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, official-domain, and archival searches were checked as applicable. Direct CIA adapter access stopped at the site's robots restriction and was not bypassed; indexed official-domain results were checked instead. The LoC adapter timed out on its first request; no success is claimed, and alternate institutional and newspaper discovery checks were performed. The NARA index page was text-extracted, rendered, and visually checked; official Army bulk data, technical documentation, and code documentation were inspected locally. No authenticated NARA Catalog API call was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review the indexed Box 815 personnel file for corroborating identifiers, the immediate pre-OSS affiliation, and the last civilian employer before wartime service.
